reviews.text: I got the color be happy with me. I think the color is accurate to the photos—a medium to deep greyed-brown. Overall, I think it will serve the purpose it’s intended for but I don’t think it’s better than other comparable products. The formula is very dry and makes the product difficult to apply evenly. You have to warm it up on your hand to get an even layer. I find the color a bit deep for fair skin, but is sheer enough where it can work if you’re careful with it. I think the product is okay, but I won’t replace it once I’m out.
reviews.zh: 我揀咗 be happy with me 呢個色。我覺得顏色同相幾乎一樣——係中等至偏深嘅灰調棕色。整體嚟講，我覺得佢可以達到原本嘅用途，但唔覺得比起其他同類產品更好。質地非常乾，令到產品好難上得均勻。一定要喺手上搓暖先可以搽到均勻。我覺得呢個色對白皙肌嚟講深咗少少，不過遮色度夠低，小心用嘅話都仲用得。我覺得呢件產品OK，但用完之後唔會回購。

reviews.text:
the product itself is nice, classic blending soft type lip liner
however the shade is so much warmer than expected, so be careful as the swatches may not be accurate irl
not bad but also nothing innovative or impressive!
reviews.zh:
產品本身唔錯，係經典嗰種軟身易推開嘅唇線筆
不過色號比預期暖好多，所以要小心，現實試色未必同網上啱
唔差但又唔算有咩新意或者特別出色！

reviews.text: So Blendable! I love the shade 01 Grin with me, very subtle, kind of "my shade but better" it was a bit darker than my lips but it was a nice touch!
reviews.zh: 超級易推開！鍾意 01 Grin with me 呢個色號，非常自然，幾乎係「用完靚過自己唇色」嘅感覺，比我原本嘅唇色深少少，但效果幾好！

reviews.text: This color 01 is exactly what I wanted. I have light olive-warm skin and darkly pigmented lips. The opacity of this formula allowed me to over line without it being obvious. I wish it had some staying power, it was gone within a couple hours.
reviews.zh: 呢個 01 號色完全係我想要嘅。我膚色係淺橄欖暖調，唇色深。呢個質地嘅遮色度令我可以畫唇線出少少都唔覺。我希望佢持久啲，兩三個鐘就甩晒。

reviews.text:
04 is much more cool tone than I expected. There's hardly a difference between 04 and 03 on my lips.

The formula has a silicone feel once on the lips. It feels a little heavy once applied, but it does blend nicely with the lip products I use on top.
reviews.zh:
04 比我想像中更加冷調。喺我嘴唇上面，04 同 03 幾乎睇唔出有分別。

質地上嘴之後有矽嘅感覺。搽完之後有少少厚重，不過同我用嘅其他唇妝產品一齊推開效果幾好。

reviews.text: Love! This is the perfect amount of matte coverage and a wonderful MLBB shade. I love using this stick for everyday wear. The smaller tip helps me apply this product with more precision.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！呢個霧面遮瑕度啱啱好，色號係超正嘅 MLBB 色。我好鍾意日常用呢支筆。筆尖比較細，可以更加精準咁上妝。

reviews.text: 유튜브 추천 보고 샀는데 살땐 너무 어두울까 걱정했는데 진짜 입술색하고 똑.같.아.서 자연스럽게 오버립이 됩니다. 너무 밝은색 립펜슬은 부자연스러울수도 있는데 진짜 입술색입니다. 지속력은 어느 립펜슬처럼 보통이예요. 다만 색이 참 괜찮습니다.
reviews.zh: 睇 YouTube 推薦買嘅，買嘅時候擔心會太深，但真係同自己唇色一.樣.一.樣.，可以好自然咁畫 over lip。太淺色嘅唇線筆有時會好假，呢支真係自己唇色。持久度同一般唇線筆差唔多。不過隻色真係幾好。

reviews.text: This is my all time favourite lipliner! I’ve gone through so many stick already and will continue to repurchase this. It’s very creamy and easy to blend, the colour is perfect for my pale lip shade.
reviews.zh: 呢支係我史上最鍾意嘅唇線筆！已經用完好多支，會繼續回購。質地好 creamy 又易推，顏色啱我偏淺嘅唇色。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
